sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that except the confession statement of accused No.3,
there is absolutely no material to connect the petitioners to the crime.
He submits that in identical circumstances, this Court in Crl.P.No.201182/2024 has quashed the criminal proceedings registered for similar offences.

4. Per contra, learned Additional Government Advocate who has appeared on behalf of the respondent Nos.1 and 2 does not dispute the submission made by the learned counsel for the petitioners that except the confession statement of accused No.3, there is no other material to connect the petitioner to the crime in question.
NC: 2026:KHC-K:2199 HC-KAR 5.
Under similar circumstances, this Court in Crl.P.No.201182/2024 disposed of on 13.01.2025 has quashed the criminal proceedings initiated with similar allegations.
Therefore, I am of the opinion that even the petitioners prayer for quashing the impugned criminal proceeding needs to be granted.

Accordingly, the following:
ORDER i) Criminal petition is allowed.
ii) The entire proceedings in C.C.No.5806/2023 pending before the Court of the Principal Civil Judge and JMFC, Aland arising out of Crime No.124/2023 registered by Aland Police Station, Kalaburagi for the offences punishable under Section 120(B)
and 420 of IPC and Sections 3, 6 and 7 of Essential Commodities Act, 1955 are quashed as against the petitioners herein.
NC: 2026:KHC-K:2199 HC-KAR

In view of disposal of petition, pending interlocutory applications,
if any do not survive for consideration.
Accordingly, they are disposed of.

Sd/-
(S.VISHWAJITH SHETTY) JUDGE SN List No.: 1 Sl No.: 35 CT:PK Rajendra vs The State Of Karnataka on 6 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82218810/
